story.title: The Last Record
story.text: The brass horn of a music machine points toward the empty floor. Its record is labelled: One more dance before the carriage comes. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

objects.label: A record waiting for one last dance
An unfinished dance card and ribbon
An unfinished dance card and ribbon

story.title: The Calling Card
story.text: An engraved tray holds a cup and a calling card. The visitor’s name has faded; the words You are welcome have not. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

story.title: The Brass Atlas
story.text: A brass globe stands over a half-open atlas. Someone circled a place that appears on no map, then wrote: Leave a light in the window. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

story.title: The Supper Kept Warm
story.text: A silver service waits beside an untouched cup. Every place has a name. The final card reads: Whoever needs a place. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

story.title: The Absent Sitter
story.text: An oval miniature rests beneath a larger frame. Its sitter is gone, but the small brass chair beside it has been carefully polished. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

story.title: The Glass Garden
story.text: A tiny fern has outgrown its specimen bell. A pressed flower beside it carries a date from next spring. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

objects.label: A fern under a specimen bell

story.title: The Unsent Letter
story.text: A jewel box stands open beside a folded letter. The ribbon has been untied and retied so often that its edges have become soft. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

objects.label: An open jewel box and unsent letter

story.title: The Little Theatre
story.text: A toy theatre waits with its curtains open. On the little stage, a painted figure is still waiting for its cue. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

objects.label: A theatre waiting for its missing player

story.title: The Patient Memorial
story.text: Black candles surround a small urn. Someone has replaced the dried flowers with a fresh green sprig. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

objects.label: An urn with a fresh green sprig

story.title: The Green Experiment
story.text: Three stoppered vessels surround a green specimen. The last notebook entry reads: It responds to kindness before it responds to light. This is an optional house memory; follow your field journal for the haunting.

story.title: Marks along the passage
story.text: Small marks in the paneling continue toward the next doorway. They look deliberate rather than accidental.
